children: Tata Power Company Limited (NSE:TATAPOWER) reported Q2 FY27 profit up 48.6% to ₹1,366 crore and revenue up 26.3% to ₹19,636 crore, while its EBITDA margin fell to 18.7%. It also approved ₹11,871 crore for a 1,800 MW pumped-storage project in Maharashtra, with completion expected in 51 months.
: Tata Power (TATAPOWER) Q2 FY27 profit rose 48.6% to ₹1,366 crore; revenue gained 26.3% to ₹19,636 crore. EBITDA margin fell to 18.7%. FY27 capex guidance: ₹25,000 crore; renewable target: 2.5 GW.
: Tata Power approved ₹11,871 crore for a 1,800 MW pumped-storage project in Shirwata, Maharashtra. Completion is expected in 51 months; 75% of funding will be debt and 25% equity.
: Tata Power expects to sign deals with Rajasthan and Haryana by December for cost-reflective tariffs at its 4-GW Mundra plant. Gujarat has agreed to fuel-linked pricing.
: Tata Power commissioned IEL’s 120 MW waste heat recovery plant, fully tied to a commercial and industrial customer, and its 164-km Jalpura-Khurja corridor, with a 1,000 MVA substation.

: Tata Power approved 6.49 million ESOP 2023 options for employees at ₹360 each, convertible into one share. Vesting runs over one to three years; none had vested or been exercised as of Nov. 11, 2026.
